summary: test_auto_sol_uses_sol_for_both_review_layers exercises real (unmocked) discover_workflows output and catches all three conjuncts via targeted monkeypatch counterexamples (auto-sol regressing to Fable+Sol, auto-spec regressing to Sol-only, and a per-workflow Sol->Fable honesty-reviewer swap all fail the assertions); minor note: _honesty_reviewer_cmd() is dead code disconnected from the rendered spec-2119 instructions, but the instructions-equality assertion independently verifies the real behavior so coverage holds.
